products.title: Drug Inventory Management System (DIMS)
products.short: IoT-powered inventory management for smarter, safer laboratory storage.
products.overview: DIMS is an IoT-enabled inventory management solution designed for laboratories, research facilities and pharmaceutical environments. It helps teams monitor inventory, storage conditions, stock levels and expiry dates through a centralized digital system, reducing manual tracking and improving operational visibility.

features.title: IoT Temperature Monitoring
features.description: Continuously monitor storage temperature and receive alerts when environmental conditions move outside defined limits.

features.title: Barcode-Based Tracking
features.description: Identify and track medicines, reagents and laboratory inventory using fast barcode-based inventory management.

features.title: Smart Stock Alerts
features.description: Receive alerts when inventory levels fall below predefined thresholds so critical materials can be replenished on time.

features.title: Expiry Monitoring
features.description: Track expiry dates and identify products approaching expiration to reduce wastage and improve inventory planning.

workflow.title: Register
workflow.description: Add medicines, reagents and laboratory materials to the digital inventory.

workflow.title: Monitor
workflow.description: Sensors and inventory records continuously provide updated information.

workflow.title: Analyze
workflow.description: View inventory levels, environmental conditions and expiry information through the dashboard.

workflow.title: Alert
workflow.description: Receive timely notifications for low stock, expiry and environmental conditions.
